title: Resource envelope
description: Every record of a resource-family capability carries this envelope beside its own fields (§9.3.4): `name`, `metadata`, and `status` for a resource the gateway converges. A resource profile's record schema declares name, metadata and (if it converges) status exactly as $defs here; its own fields sit at the top of the record.

name.description: The resource name: its domain, then collection and id pairs, stable for its life (resource-name in grammar.abnf).

metadata.description: Written by the gateway, except labels; ignored in a create or update body.

uid.description: The resource's unique id, never reused.

etag.description: As the ETag header: an entity-tag with its quotes. Moves with generation, never with status.

generation.description: Moves on every change to the record's own fields or labels, never on a status change.

updated.description: When its own fields or labels last changed.

labels.description: The caller's labels: the one member of metadata a caller writes.

deleting.description: When a delete began that is still removing what the resource made; null otherwise.

status.description: Only on a resource the gateway converges; written by its controller only.

observed_generation.description: The generation the controller last acted on.

conditions.description: One per type; every converged resource has `ready`.

items.description: A condition. Types and reasons are open sets: a client keeps one it does not know.

type.description: The condition's type: ready, or one of the resource's own.

x-atlas-enum.description: A status this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

reason.description: A reason code; an open set.

observed_generation.description: The generation it was observed for; below metadata.generation it is out of date.
